why: Resolved styles (design/ui-layers.md). The tree layer and lane A read className as text; the styles layer reads it as the declarations of its classes under the pinned Tailwind configuration. Badge's text-sm becomes text-base: another font size and line height, a WITNESS in both layers. Card reorders its classes: a tree WITNESS (the attribute's text) and equal in the styles layer (the same classes). Box writes p-4 as px-4 py-4: the same four padding declarations, equal in the styles layer. Chip changes px-2 to px-3 beside chip-primary, a class outside the pinned table: the styles layer reports it unknown, never equal and never a styles WITNESS. Tag builds the same class string through a local: proved, equal in both layers. Plain is untouched.
